items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I must mention to you, there was trumpet player named Joe Sutler that nobody mentions.

ctx.x: All the musicians and all the entertainers from all the other clubs are coming over there to play and hang out and these go on „til noon Sunday. TAYLOR; I‟ll be darned.
Then we had the Bookstore, a place called the Bookstore, after hour place. And I must mention to you, there was trumpet player named Joe Sutler that nobody mentions.
